method.currentChanges: Read complete new consent, native-identity helper transport, provider-switch and live-list modules, and complete current service/providers/native launch/activity integration. Reviewed current changed test bodies/assertions and author results without rerunning them.
method.historyAndSwitch: Trace cold resume and warm provider/same-provider repair: exact source/target consent before detachment, idle/goal/queue/owner checks, real thread/closed waiter installed before unsubscribe, unconditional fresh post-close inspection, writer-locked helper contract, acknowledged repair/resume errors remain unknown and inputSent:false, and no automatic replay. Public history and attachment ownership rehydration precede input.
method.compatibility: Foreign fork lineage/opaque compaction and unknown formats reject conversion without altering active history. Same-provider ordinary load remains available for unsupported inspection, without caching a compatibility proof. Fully inspected plain ancestor prefixes may cache a negative plaintext finding; closed/reverted/provider changes invalidate that proof. Current helper body is outside this independent scope because this reviewer authored it.
method.listing: Main thread/list includes all providers while preserving native data/cursors and scope. Positive new-thread/fork acknowledgements retain separately bounded live summaries until persistence/closure; capacity reservations release on all exits. Existing ancestor list and search are checked against their distinct native parameter contracts.
method.adjacent: Fresh session/history/activity/queue/goal/attachment/permissions/terminal/workspace and service lifecycle review; owner-specific history watermarks, pending/unknown barriers, replay ownership, accepted postprocessing, and cleanup evidence retained. Other unchanged adapters retain prior complete semantics with explicitly limited current callsite/structure checks.
method.tests: No new tests, full suite, typecheck, network freshness, remote operation, or inference executed by this reviewer in this review closure. Test totals are separate source-bound runs, not summed as unique current full-suite coverage.
method.independence: Runtime changes were authored by the runtime/listing agents. This reviewer authored deploy/thread_history.py and associated control/sudo changes; those are excluded from independent approval here and rely on root plus the separately bound deployment reviewer.
